text: All right, do you have a man or somebody that's really hard to buy for in your life? Let me tell you why you need one of these. So this is one I just ordered, but we already have one, and this is something I use all the time. It is a Rubik's Cube-shaped 55-in-1 screwdriver. It includes bits for phones, tablets, game consoles, household appliances, glasses, cameras, and everyday home repairs. It also comes with pry tools, small wrenches, cutting tools, nut drivers, and a handle with a super strong magnet. The handle can be extended, shortened, or configured into an L-shape, giving you better reach, more control, and extra torque. No more digging through your entire toolbox just to find one tiny bit. If your husband or dad is obsessed with little gadgets like this, Christmas is just around the corner, so grab one while it's on sale and surprise him with it.
